<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=o1KmzTMjk0bFgBX4XkYu <nowiki>Necromancy - Low-level</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=qkkKruNMoSgfdr7aFWra <nowiki>Necromancy - High-level</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ A low-level preset (~47 KPH) is provided for when minions cannot (yet) be skipped:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1" alt="darkness" title="darkness" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to help with survivability.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1" alt="darkness" title="darkness" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is not required for survival you can use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1233722649834684416.png?v=1" alt="equilibriumaura" title="equilibriumaura" kind="icon" /><nowiki> instead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The First Necromancer gear (+ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1" alt="cinderbanes" title="cinderbanes" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ) can also be used for similar KPH.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1" alt="ruination" title="ruination" kind="icon" /><nowiki> over </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1" alt="sorrow" title="sorrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is a small KPH increase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FqkkKruNMoSgfdr7aFWra.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="action-bars"><nowiki>Action Bars </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ High-level: minion skips</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/ASHd9IMRen.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Low-level: without minion skips</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/Fb65eOtSjY.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
 ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If healing is an issue, put </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1" alt="bloodsiphon" title="bloodsiphon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1" alt="conjureskeleton" title="conjureskeleton" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="kph"><nowiki>KPH </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At Level 120 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> one can expect ~40s kill times and ~55 KPH with the high-level method.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The low-level method yields ~47 KPH with t90 weapons, t80 power armour and Level 90 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>; assuming the method requirements are met.</nowiki></p>
